computer_upgrade_progress_awaiting_stage: Upgrade requested; waiting for the Computer to report stage progress.
computer_upgrade_progress_downloading_de: Fetching the update package for verification.
computer_upgrade_progress_verifying_deta: Verifying the integrity of the update package.
computer_upgrade_progress_draining_detai: Update verified; waiting for active Agent turns to finish.
computer_upgrade_progress_switching_deta: Switching to the target version and restarting the service.
computer_upgrade_progress_target_online_: Confirming the switch result with the installer.
Wait ended; the new version is online, but the installer has not returned a confirmed switch result.
computer_upgrade_progress_confirmed_all_: Switch to the new version is confirmed.
computer_upgrade_progress_confirmed_none: No visible workspaces were running before the switch.
computer_upgrade_progress_rolled_back_un: This upgrade did not complete, and the restored version could not be confirmed.
computer_upgrade_progress_uncertain_deta: Wait ended; the installer did not return a confirmed switch result.
computer_upgrade_progress_conflict_detai: Conflicting upgrade evidence was reported; check the Computer's status.
